title: Install or recover Usher
summary: Deploy or recover the stateless Usher CLI and its version-matched Chancery selector without changing semantic registration or any product runtime.
use_when: Usher should be installed, updated, or recovered for the current macOS user.
do_not_use_when: Only membership should be reported; use usher.recognition.inspect.
A foreign selector should be adopted or another product should be changed.
outcome: A version-matched immutable release with coherent Usher CLI and provider selectors.
effects: Stages an immutable Usher release, holds product and catalog writer locks, and advances owned CLI and provider selectors through one current release.
No service state or semantic registration is touched.
authority: Usher owns its release and selectors. Cell products retain all domain and declaration authority.
success: Candidate/provider versions match; installed help/version and release integrity checks pass; owned selectors follow current.
failure_and_recovery: Refuse foreign, tampered, stale, or unprovable selections. On failed publication restore prior selectors; use the exact retained previous release deployer and binary for deliberate recovery.
privacy: Release documentation contains no secrets or live records. Recognition metadata remains caller-owned output.
steps: Build a green candidate with ./ci.sh usher.
Run the product deployer with the exact binary and optional expected current selector.
Verify version, help, immutable release, and owned Chancery selector.
checkpoints: Version, integrity, ownership, and prior selection are established before advancing selectors.
Deployment creates no semantic project, database, worker, or schedule.
adaptation: Use --expected-current absent|releases/HASH to bind deployment to an observed selection. Use --home only for an intentional isolated or alternate-user boundary.
stop_when: A candidate or selector is foreign, stale, tampered, or cannot be restored coherently.
does_not_authorize: Release publication, foreign-selector takeover, retained-release deletion, or semantic registration.

consumers.statement: The current operator may install or recover Usher.

preconditions.statement: A green version-matched candidate and owned coherent prior release/selector basis.

inputs.statement: Exact release binary, product deployer and bundle, optional expected current, and optional isolated home.

outputs.statement: A version-matched immutable release with coherent Usher CLI and provider selectors.

data_semantics.statement: Release selectors establish installed bytes, not Cell membership or runtime readiness.

identity_and_units.statement: Product release version and content-addressed release identity are separate from capability contract and JSON schema versions.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: The operation covers the selected candidate and exact prior release basis.

access.statement: Current-user local filesystem and shell, bounded to product-owned files and selectors.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Product lock precedes catalog writer lock. One atomic current selector selects program and documentation; failed publication restores prior selectors.

operational_limits.statement: No daemon, schedule, database, semantic registration, or other product runtime is operated.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Generated selector-only deployment profile v1, product version, provider release, and entry contract version remain distinct.

reliances.statement: Deployment uses the product-owned generated local deployer; it does not invoke represented products.
